notes.title: Get your hand on Play Me!
notes.notes:
[b]We released Play Me yesterday and it was a blast for us![/b]

So many of you are getting the game and trying it, and we’re so honored about that. We’re already receiving a lot of feedback from you, so we can get even more updates to make it more satisfying for you.

In this Early Access stage, we’re focusing on creating more stuff so you can Play Me with more assets, and solving some bugs and issues with the sex animations. If you have any suggestions or tips, don't hesitate to talk to us.

We're working hard to create the best sex game. Thanks everyone for testing Play Me and supporting our work at Gazzing Studios. ;)
